items.text: Sunday #FantasyFootball injuries: IN Kyler Murray, Aaron Jones, Sam Darnold, Jadarian Price, JK Dobbins, RJ Harvey, Malik Nabers, Travis Etienne... DOUBTFUL Puka Nacua OUT Jayden Daniels, Nico Collins, Rico Dowdle, Alec Pierce, Jonathon Brooks...
items.implication: Key status locks for Week 3 lineups; Brooks IR solidifies Hubbard

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday’s game. Sam Darnold is off the injury report and good to go for Seahawks.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; positive long-term as not IR
items.opportunity: Mariota era target shares for WAS pass-catchers

items.text: Texans have ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday’s game at Indianapolis due to his hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury, missed practice all week
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Houston passing game
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for remaining pass-catchers

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle for Sunday’s game vs. the Bengals due to his toe injury. RB Jaylen Warren is questionable for Sunday due to his shoulder injury.
items.why: Toe injury, boot earlier in week, DNP
items.opportunity: Lead RB role + checkdowns for Warren

items.text: Puka Nacua will not practice and will be listed as doubtful for the game against the Broncos. Sean McVay believes that, barring a setback, Puka Nacua could return next week vs. the Eagles.
items.implication: Likely OUT; Adams carries load; expected back Week 4
items.opportunity: Increased volume for Davante Adams and Rams WRs

items.text: Projections for Sunday's Week 3 main slate are live. Reminder that our ceiling projections are the average of the top 25th percentile outcomes in our sim. I believe Jahmyr Gibbs has set a new record there at 44.0.
items.why: Record high ceiling in ETR sims

items.text: Broncos ruled out RB Jonah Coleman for Sunday night’s game vs. Rams due to his ankle injury. RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey are off the injury report and good to go vs. the Rams.
items.implication: Full Broncos RB committee available; Coleman OUT

items.text: Vertical pass game has not worked for Aaron Rodgers through two weeks. Perhaps spamming Jaylen Warren with a zillion checkdowns will. Expecting practice squad callup Travis Homer and 7th-round rookie Eli Heidenreich as Warren's backups Sunday. Coach: Warren going to lead the group.
items.why: Dowdle OUT; coach confirms lead role; checkdown potential

items.text: Packers WR routes run last night, first game without Jayden Reed (neck/back). On 55 Jordan Love dropbacks: 1. Christian Watson 45 2. Matthew Golden 44. Watson & Golden have combined to see 48% of Love's targets so far.
items.implication: Sustained WR1 upside in GB offense

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected to land on IR. That pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into the lead role, with AJ Dillon as primary backup.
items.why: Limited games across seasons, IR expected

items.text: RB Love: Derrick Henry vs. DAL (Brazil): Henry's rushing yards prop line (88.5) is the highest among all running backs in Week 3, and Dallas ranks 30th in rush defense through two weeks, allowing 173.5 yards per game on the ground. Feed him.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D, high prop

items.text: Pass catchers Love: Chris Olave vs. LV (double-digit targets, high aDOT, LV allows league-high YPR); Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% target share last week sans Collins, IND allows 4th-most TE yards). Also Chase Brown love for volume.
items.why: Usage + matchup edges; Collins absence boosts Schultz
items.opportunity: Target share spikes and favorable DVP

items.text: Kyle Pitts has only run a route on 63% of the dropbacks this season. He has six targets through three games, a pathetic 8% share. Pitts targets per route run last two seasons: With Drake London off field: 33% With Drake London on field: 17%.
items.why: Low route % and target share, suppressed by London

items.text: RBs Hate: Travis Etienne vs. LV (only 49% touches, 38% 3rd down snaps); Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble, tough run D). Fact: Henderson led with 65% snaps after Stevenson fumble.
items.opportunity: Henderson gaining but not full takeover yet
